title: Processing a Signed Cancellation: Credits and Refund — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
## Cancellation credit and refund on NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)

When the named insured's signed cancellation request on an NFIP Dwelling Form policy is processed, cancellation credits are posted to the premium account and a refund is paid out on the terms below.

**Scope.** For a policy whose current term carries an endorsement charge or a re-rate credit, or whose cancellation takes effect on or before the current term start, and only for such a policy, the charges of the current term are returned as this schedule provides, each endorsement charge and re-rate credit of the term being taken back in the part this schedule gives, judged on the coverage increase most recently put into effect and the applied certificate most recently recorded; on every other policy Pro Rata returns the current term's risk premium, ICC premium, Reserve Fund Assessment and HFIAA surcharge multiplied by the days from the cancellation effective date to the term end divided by the days from the term start to the term end.

**When the credit is fixed.** The cancellation credit is fixed only after the policy carries the named insured's signed cancellation request stating the date the cancellation takes effect. The cancellation credit is fixed only after the premium account carries the charge for every coverage increase the insured requested on the current term, because the cancellation returns the term's charges line by line.

### Calling `process_policy_cancellation_6794673f`

`process_policy_cancellation_6794673f` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it with the figures already worked out; it checks no eligibility and computes nothing.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `dwelling_policy_id` | The NFIP Dwelling Form policy being cancelled, as returned by the policy lookup | Identifier |
| `dwelling_request_id` | The signed cancellation request, as returned when the insured signed it or by the request lookup for that policy | Identifier |
| `risk_premium_credit` | Cancellation credit on the risk premium line | US dollars, non-negative, 2 decimals, already rounded half-up to the cent |
| `reserve_fund_credit` | Cancellation credit on the reserve fund assessment line | As above |
| `hfiaa_credit` | Cancellation credit on the HFIAA surcharge line | As above |
| `icc_credit` | Cancellation credit on the ICC premium line | As above; zero on a tier with no ICC coverage |
| `refund_amount` | The refund paid out with the cancellation | As above; when it is zero no refund payment is issued |
| `payee` | Who receives the refund: `INSURED` when the insured is the premium payor of record; `LENDER_ESCROW` when the lender paying from the borrower's escrow account is the premium payor of record; `NONE` when no refund is paid out | Enumerated value |

**Effect.** The policy is marked cancelled with the reason and effective date stated on the request and today's date as the processing date; cancellation credits are posted to the premium account for the current term on the four lines, each referencing the request (a line whose credit is zero is not posted); and one refund payment of the stated amount is issued to the stated payee against the premium account, referencing the request, with a refund check or ACH reference. The credits lower the amount owed and the refund raises it by the amount paid out.

**Return.** "Policy <policy reference> cancelled effective <YYYY-MM-DD> (<reason>); credits posted: <entry reference> <component> <amount>, ...; refund <refund reference> of <amount> to <payee>; balance now <amount>." Amounts are US dollars with 2 decimals; the balance is the amount owed afterwards.
